truth_note: Thresholds and ticket strategy are selected only on 8/29. 8/30 is scored once as holdout.
base_policy: Keep the same horse ranking foundation; improve PASS/axis fixation/ticket-shape conversion only.

ticket_shapes.AXIS7: top1 fixed; 7 trio combinations when score gap is strong
ticket_shapes.DUAL9: top2 centered; up to 9 combinations when two horses form the core
ticket_shapes.GROUP10: top5 box-like 10 combinations when axis fixation is weak

limitations: Only one weekend is available. Holdout sample remains small.
This is a PDCA candidate, not production promotion.
Odds/popularity are excluded from horse ranking and calibration.
